node.text: 已解出 45 题 · 作文范文 2 篇

21. Which team will play the most games at the stadium this month? A. Washington Commanders. B. Los Angeles Rams. C. Los Angeles Chargers. D. New Orleans Saints. 答案：B 原文明确说Rams每个赛季在此打最多的主场比赛。
22. Which hotel is the nearest to the stadium? A. Sonder Lum Hotel. B. The Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles. C. The H Hotel Los Angeles. D. The Renaissance LA Airport Hotel 答案：A Sonder Lum Hotel就在体育场街对面，距离最近。
23. What do you need to do if you want to park at the stadium? A. Call the parking staff. B. Prepay the parking fee. C. Obtain a parking pass. D. Choose a parking zone. 答案：C 原文建议通过ParkWhiz提前购买停车通行证。
24. What does Kevin usually do to get the meaning of a word? A. Use electronic devices. B. Consult a paper dictionary. C. Guess from the context. D. Turn to his English teacher. 答案：A Kevin说“你就不能用手机查吗”，说明他通常用电子设备查词。
25. How did Kevin feel while looking up the word in the dictionary? A. Annoyed. B. Disappointed. C. Encouraged. D. Astonished. 答案：D 他看到整页都是相同开头字母的单词时既惊恐又惊叹，即感到惊讶。
26. What can we learn about the author's first dictionary? A. It helped her through the college. B. It was given to Kevin as a gift. C. It bore witness to her efforts. D. It was a valuable limited edition. 答案：C 作者在词典上给查过的词打点，词典见证了她的努力。
27. What has the author come to realize about learning? A. It is never too late to start. B. Motivation is what really matters. C. Children need role models. D. Dictionaries are still a useful tool. 答案：B 作者领悟到关键不是词典或单词本身，而是想知道的渴望与好奇心。
28. What does the new study imply regarding oaks and sweetgums? A. They affect the growth of other trees. B. They absorb less carbon than expected. C. They harm people's health indirectly. D. They raise the local temperature slowly. 答案：C 橡树和枫香树释放的异戊二烯与氮氧化物生成臭氧，间接危害健康。
29. Which of the following may Commane suggest based on their study? A. Cutting down the isoprene-producing trees. B. Suspending tree-planting for a few decades. C. Changing the species of trees in new plantings. D. Removing isoprene released by existing trees. 答案：C Commane强调种树要谨慎，暗示应改变新植树种的种类。
30. What does the underlined phrase "oblivious to" in paragraph 5 mean? A. Honest about. B. Unaware of. C. Related to. D. Optimistic about. 答案：B oblivious to意为“未意识到”，即unaware of。
31. What would Auyeung probably advocate? A. Reducing car use in daily life. B. Providing animals with new habitats. C. Controlling population growth. D. Doing more research on the problem. 答案：A Auyeung说要反思以汽车为中心的生活方式，即倡导减少用车。
32. What was the task of the “beauty” group? A. Matching line drawings with objects. B. Rating how beautiful each object was. C. Creating their own clay objects. D. Describing their daily worries. 答案：B “美”组被要求给每件作品的美感打分。
33. According to the study, which group was more likely to think beyond daily life? A. The beauty group, who showed greater interest in bigger questions. B. The beauty group, who felt much happier afterwards. C. The control group, who showed stronger abstract thinking. D. The control group, who felt more enlightened. 答案：A 美组在抽象思维上得分更高，对人生大问题兴趣更浓。
34. Why did the researchers ask about the participants’ feelings? A. To compare the two groups’ scores. B. To judge their specific thinking pattern. C. To measure the difficulty of the task. D. To identify the true factor behind the results. 答案：D 询问情绪是为了排除心情因素，确定真正起作用的原因。
35. What does the study encourage people to do? A. Visit galleries more often. B. Spend less time on screens. C. Buy handmade ceramics. D. Develop their critical thinking. 答案：B Schnall建议人们放慢脚步欣赏美，减少对屏幕的依赖。
36. Walk into many modern galleries today and an AI-powered guide can chat with you, answer your questions, and share fascinating stories about the works on display. 36__________. 答案：C 该句总结AI正多方面改变博物馆体验，承接上文导览功能。
37. 37__________ Virtual guides can respond in dozens of languages and adjust their tone to suit each listener, whether a young student or a lifelong art lover. 答案：F 下文讲虚拟导览多语言、调语气，说明AI聊天机器人取代传统语音导览。
38. 38__________ Moreover, it can predict how a fragile painting may age over the years, allowing experts to step in before any visible damage appears. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：A 下文讲AI能预测画作老化，说明其是艺术品修复的有力工具。
39. 39__________ For instance, a curious child and a trained art expert standing before the same painting might each receive a completely different guided tour. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：D 下文举例不同观众获得不同导览，说明AI按年龄和学习风格定制推荐。
40. 40__________ Strict rules are therefore needed to ensure that every visitor's privacy is fully protected. A. These capabilities make AI a powerful tool for art restoration. B. Visitor data, if misused, could lead to serious privacy issues. C. In short, AI is changing the museum experience in many respects. D. It tailors recommendations to different ages and learning styles. E. Museums have always been important places for learning. F. Furthermore, AI chatbots are replacing traditional audio guides. G. AI is also used to design more attractive exhibits. 答案：B 上文讲收集大量个人信息，下文说需要规则保护隐私，故填隐私风险句。
41. The 41______ that people only really knew Ohio for the three C's - Cleveland, Cincinnati, or Columbus (not Cortland!) - came quickly when I decided to go to school in central Pennsylvania. A. fantasy B. prejudice C. realization D. expectation 答案：C 作者离家上学后很快“意识到”人们只知俄亥俄三大城市。
42. Half of my peers didn't even realize I lived a 42 ______ three and a half hours away. A. only B. indeed C. still D. even 答案：A 同学不知道她住得“只”有三个半小时车程。
43. The 43 ______ are never-ending. A. tests B. questions C. games D. debates 答案：B 后面列举的都是同学们连珠炮似的“问题”。
44. I was a unicorn in their eyes, a 44 ______ Or, on second thought, maybe just a country hick. A. success B. victim C. novelty D. problem 答案：C 她在同学眼中像独角兽，是个“新奇事物”。
45. As I grow older, I'm more and more 45 ______ for my small town roots. A. thankful B. hopeful C. suitable D. reliable 答案：A be thankful for表示对小镇根源心怀感激。
46. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. dream B. lie C. hear D. complain 答案：D complain about表示抱怨在偏僻地方很无聊。
47. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. therefore B. however C. instead D. otherwise 答案：B 前后为转折关系，用however。
48. Sure, my friends and I loved to 46 ______ about how bored we were in the middle of nowhere, 47 ______, as I finish up my junior year of college, I'm convinced that it took 48 ______ our small town to realize how much we actually did love it and what exactly we loved about it. A. touring B. challenging C. leaving D. protecting 答案：C “离开”小镇后才意识到自己多爱它。
49. For one, the pace of life isn't anxiety provoking and people really 49 ______ connecting to each other. A. value B. admit C. fear D. remember 答案：A 人们真正“重视”彼此间的联系。
50. That means that you do more than just talk to your next door neighbors - in a lot of cases, they're truly an 50 ______ of your family. A. advantage B. example C. owner D. extension 答案：D 邻居实际上是家庭的“延伸”。
51. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. lifestyle B. landscape C. procedure D. personality 答案：A 这种“生活方式”围绕户外活动展开。
52. So much of this 51 ______ revolves around being outside and knowing the ins and outs of the town, being present and mindful of your 52 ______ is a critical part of the culture. A. findings B. surroundings C. belongings D. greetings 答案：B 留意自己的“周围环境”是文化的重要部分。
53. As I move through my college years, I 53 ______ the visits to my little hometown. A. give up B. put off C. face up to D. look forward to 答案：D look forward to表示期待回小镇的探访。
54. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：C 感激成长中拥有的“童年/经历”，结合语境选childhood。
55. I am grateful for the 54 ______ that I had growing up and know that wherever my next adventure takes me, I can 55 ______ my small town roots to lead me in the right direction. 答案：B 让小镇根源“指引”自己走向正确方向，选rely on/let…guide，此处填trust。
56. It is also common for them 56 ____ (hold) on traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival, also known as the Chinese New Year, and Mid-Autumn Festival, as well as other local festivals. 答案：to be held be common for sth to be done，且大集是被举办的，用不定式被动。
57. The exact dates and 57 ____ (frequent) of daji vary from region to region. 答案：frequency 与dates并列作主语，需名词形式frequency。
58. Dajis evolved from the folk custom of trading goods, which can be traced back to 58 ___ Han Dynasty (202 B.C.-A.D. 答案：the 朝代前用定冠词the Han Dynasty。
59. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ___ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ___ (necessity). 答案：were 主语transportation and communication为复数，且叙述过去，用were。
60. In the old days, transportation and communication 59 ___ (be) so poor that it was challenging for households to exchange items to meet their needs for daily 60 ___ (necessity). 答案：necessities daily necessities日常必需品，用复数。
61. They would trade their surplus items 61 ___ the goods they needed. 答案：for trade A for B用介词for表示交换。
62. 62 ___ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63 ___ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：Drawn 过去分词作状语，表被香气吸引。
63. 62 ___ (Draw) by the enticing aromas, they hurry to food stalls, 63 ___ steamed dumplings and hot noodle soups. 答案：where 非限制性定语从句修饰food stalls，表地点用where。
64. Before 64 ___ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ___ (cheap) than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：heading before后接动名词heading。
65. Before 64 ___ (head) back home, they purchase some fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, which are much 65 ___ (cheap) than those in supermarkets, and embark on their journey back home. 答案：cheaper much修饰比较级，用cheaper。
